name: Makalu Base Camp Trek
sub_region: Sankhuwasabha District, Koshi Province; Makalu-Barun National Park

difficulty.notes: Remote trek with a steep 1,400 m climb from Tashigaon to Khongma Danda and a high traverse over Shipton La (approx. 4,216 m) and Keke La (approx. 4,127 m), which is crossed twice (in and out). Basic lodges/camping.

duration_days.basis: Full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu (fly Tumlingtar, jeep to Num)
duration_days.notes: Older itineraries start walking from Tumlingtar or Chichira; road access now reaches Num. Some itineraries add Kathmandu days or extra exploration days in the upper Barun valley. Helicopter exits are used by some groups.

itinerary.notes: Tumlingtar approx. 457 m. Long rough drive via Khandbari and Chichila.
Makalu-Barun NP permit registered at Seduwa.
1,400 m ascent through rhododendron and fir forest.

itinerary.route: Khongma Danda - Shipton La (approx. 4,216 m) - Keke La - Dobato
itinerary.notes: Frozen tarns; first big mountain views.
Below Makalu's south face, on the Barun glacier moraine.

itinerary.route: Exploration day at Makalu Base Camp (toward Swiss Base Camp / Makalu La viewpoints)
itinerary.notes: On clear days Everest and Lhotse visible; also Baruntse and Chamlang.

itinerary.route: Dobato - Keke La - Shipton La - Khongma Danda

itinerary.notes: Keep a contingency day for weather.

best_seasons.notes: NTB: best Oct-Nov and Mar-Apr; Apr-May hot at lower elevations; Jun-Sep monsoon. Shipton La can be snowbound in winter.

permits.name: Makalu-Barun National Park entry
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Makalu Basecamp Trek is on the NTB guide-and-TIMS list

permits.name: Sankhuwasabha restricted area permit (Bhotkhola RM wards 1-5, Makalu RM ward 4)
permits.fee: USD 20 per person per week for first 4 weeks; USD 25 per week beyond
permits.applies_to: only if the route enters the listed restricted wards (e.g. Kimathanka side); not normally required for the standard Num-Barun route

guide_requirements: Makalu Basecamp Trek is on the NTB list of routes where foreign trekkers must be accompanied by a licensed trekking guide and carry an agency-issued TIMS card (provision effective 31 March / 1 April 2023).

drives: Tumlingtar - Khandbari - Chichila - Num (jeep, rough road)
logistics.notes: Basic lodges along most of the route; some operators run fully supported camping. NTB lists Makalu-Barun NP accommodation as camping.

highlights: Makalu (8,485 m) south face from base camp
Barun valley glaciers, waterfalls and cliffs
Shipton La and Keke La high traverse with alpine lakes
Makalu-Barun NP biodiversity: red panda, snow leopard habitat, 25 of Nepal's 30 rhododendron species (NTB)
risks: Remote; few rescue options other than helicopter
Snow/ice on Shipton La outside season

acclimatization.notes: Rest day at Khongma Danda before Shipton La is standard.

unverified: Whether any restricted area permit is needed for the standard Makalu BC route: Makalu RM ward 4 appears on the restricted list; operators generally list only the national park fee and TIMS. Confirm with agency/DoI.
Shipton La height quoted 4,216 m (also 4,170 m in some sources); Keke La 4,127 m.
Makalu Base Camp altitude for trekkers 4,870 m (Himalayan Database expedition BC entry also 4,870 m); climbers' Hillary BC quoted up to 5,250 m by Explorersweb.
